recruitment_summary: The SSC MTS 2025 cycle facilitates entry-level recruitment for the Government of India. For the 2025-26 cycle, SSC announced a total of 7,948 vacancies (MTS: 6,810; Havaldar: 1,138). The Computer Based Examination was conducted in February 2026. As of April 1, 2026, the provisional answer keys have been processed, and the final CBT result is expected by mid-April, which will shortlist candidates for Havaldar PET/PST and MTS Document Verification.

overview_extended.Selection_Architecture: CBT (Session I & II) -> PET/PST (Havaldar Only) -> Final Merit
overview_extended.Pay_Scale: Pay Level-1 as per 7th CPC (Initial Pay approx. ₹18,000 + Allowances)

exam_pattern_ultra.Mandatory_Sessions: Both Session I and II are conducted on the same day. Session I is qualifying; Session II determines the rank.

how_to_check_results: 1. Visit ssc.gov.in and go to the 'Result' tab.
2. Select the 'Others' tab to find MTS/Havaldar 2025 links.
3. Download the PDF containing Roll Numbers of shortlisted candidates.
4. Use 'Ctrl+F' to search for your name/roll number.
5. If listed, keep the registration details ready for the PET/PST or DV stage.
